articles.title: IAF is not against theaterisation, says Air Chief Marshal AP Singh
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) supports the concept of theaterisation but emphasizes a cautious, objective approach to its implementation. It advocates for any new initiative to ensure minimal disruption to existing command structures. This stance reflects the IAF's desire for effective integration and enhanced jointness, while preserving operational efficiency during significant military reforms aiming for unified commands across services.

articles.title: IAF is not against theaterisation: Air Chief Marshal Singh
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) supports theaterisation but insists on an objective approach for any new initiative. Their primary concern is ensuring minimal disruption to existing structures and maintaining operational effectiveness during the integration process. This pragmatic stance highlights the IAF's commitment to strategic restructuring while safeguarding current defence capabilities and ensuring smooth transitions.

articles.title: Panama-flagged cargo ship sinks in Bay of Bengal, rescue ops on
articles.summary: A Panama-flagged cargo ship sank in the Bay of Bengal on Saturday, approximately 240 nautical miles off Odisha's Paradip coast. The vessel, carrying 24 crew members, was en route when the incident occurred. This highlights maritime safety challenges and the need for robust search and rescue capabilities in India’s immediate waters, a crucial aspect for SSB aspirants studying national security.

articles.title: Mapping India’s space-tech opportunity: Which listed stocks to buy, which unlisted companies to track
articles.summary: India's space journey, once synonymous with ISRO's achievements like Aryabhata, Chandrayaan, and Mangalyaan, is now undergoing a significant transformation. This shift, beginning recently, indicates a move beyond ISRO's sole dominance towards greater private sector participation and new policies. This heralds a new era for India's space sector, signifying diversification and enhanced innovation in its expanding space capabilities.

articles.title: IAF turning to predictive AI and digital twins to prepare for future challenges: Air Chief Marshal AP Singh
articles.summary: IAF Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh highlighted Artificial Intelligence's pivotal role in modern defence planning. He stated the Indian Air Force is actively leveraging predictive AI and digitization to enhance operational efficiency, threat assessment, and overall future warfare readiness. This strategic integration underscores the IAF's commitment to technological advancement and smart defence capabilities for SSB aspirants to note.

articles.title: North Korea says record-high Japan defence budget would risk 'turmoil'
articles.summary: North Korea condemned Japan's plans to significantly increase its defence budget, accusing Tokyo of preparing for a "war of aggression." Pyongyang views this military expansion as a dangerous move, potentially escalating regional tensions. This criticism arises even as the US, Japan's key ally, pursues diplomatic talks with North Korea, underscoring complex security dynamics in Northeast Asia.
